rows.question: Write a piece of continuous prose in Russian (140 words) in answer to ONE of the following. In your answer make sure to include ALL the points listed. 1. LETTER You are away from home participating in an exchange. Write a letter to your parents asking them if a new friend can visit you in your home. In your letter make reference to the following: • How your exchange is going • Information about your new friend (physical description; age; character; interests; studying or working etc.) • Possible dates of the visit • Activities planned for the visit. 2. NARRATIVE Write the outline of the story of your favourite book or film. 3. DISCUSSION Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of student exchange programmes.
rows.heading: Guided / Extended Writing (Letter, Continuous Prose)

rows.question:
Write a short essay (50 words) in Russian on one of the following topics. Supply five factual details. Marks are awarded for relevant content, expression and structure (organisation of ideas). Indicate which essay you are writing by supplying the essay title.

Напишите небольшую статью по–русски размером 50 слов на одну из следующих тем. В свою статью 
включите пять страноведческих фактов. 
 
1. 
An córas oideachais i gCónaidhm na Rúise / The education system in the Russian Federation / 
Oбразование в Российской Федерции 
 
2. 
An teaghlach i gCónaidhm na Rúise / The family in the Russian Federation / Семья в Российской 
Федерции 
 
3. 
Áiteanna a mbíonn an-tóir ag turasóirí orthu / áiteanna spéisiúla ó thaobh na staire agus an chultúir de 
i gCónaidhm na Rúise / Places of historic and cultural interest in the Russian Federation / 
Достопримечательности в Российской Федерации 
 
4. 
Ceol / ceoltóirí i gCónaidhm na Rúise Music / Music / musicians in the Russian Federation / 
Музыка/музыканты в Российской Федерации 
 
5. 
An Rúisis in Éirinn / The Russian language in Ireland / Русский язык в Ирландии
rows.heading: Short Essay (~50 Words, HL)
